title: The sauna ticks itself
lines: When the sauna timer runs out, Sauna is ticked for you at the time it ended, and the sauna habit with it.
It works from Today too, if you’ve left the sauna screen. Tap it to untick if you didn’t go.

title: Race timer fixed, and the gym habit has a 30-minute rule
lines: The race timer kept running after Start workout: the planner wasn’t seeing that day’s own session. Fixed, and the same fix stops “Did you miss the gym today?” showing after you’ve been.
“Get to the gym” now only ticks itself if you press Start workout within 30 minutes of I’m up.
Today’s tick is taken off: you started at 6:29, 69 minutes after 5:20.

title: Talk instead of typing, and room to think
lines: Drag RV up to Arvy or to the chat and hold it there for two seconds: it opens listening, so you can just talk.
In the chat, what you say goes into the message box. Tap Send when it’s right. There’s a mic button there too.
Talking now waits for a pause of two and a half seconds before it decides you’ve finished.

title: Your gym habit ticks itself at Start workout
lines: A habit can now tick itself when you press Start workout in Training, the same moment your race timer stops.
“Get to the gym and do the first set” is set up that way already.
Throw the session away and the tick comes off again.

title: Your race now finishes at Start workout
lines: The gym race stops the moment you press Start workout in Training, not at your first set.
Past days are worked out again the same way, so your best still compares like with like.
Want the first set instead? Edit the timer in Settings › Arrange Today and pick Up to first set.

title: Race your mornings
lines: New on Today: a race timer. Add it in Settings › Arrange Today.
“Up to first set” runs from I’m up to your first set in the gym, with your best beside it.
Or make your own with Start and Stop: out the door, kids to bed.
Tap it to see the last 30 days.

title: A sound for each kind of notification
lines: Settings › Sounds: pick a sound for the chat, one for Arvy, and one for reminders. Tap ▶ to hear them.
They play while the planner is open on screen.
When it’s closed your phone plays its own sound. Switch that off for any of the three to get those notifications quietly.

title: Ask Arvy in your chat with each other
lines: Start a message in your chat with RV or Arvy and it answers right there, where you both see it.
It can do what it does in its own chat: look up places (with Call, Website and Directions buttons), search the web, read the calendar.
Nothing is added by itself: what Arvy sets up waits on its message for a Confirm tap. Something that is only yours, only you can confirm.
Your own things stay out unless you ask for them there. Email, the cycle tracker and Arvy’s notes about you are never used in the shared chat.

title: Connect your Gmail to Arvy
lines: Settings › Email: connect your Gmail. You sign in on Google’s own page, and each of you connects your own.
Ask Arvy “anything important in my email?” and it tells you what matters. It only looks when you ask.
Ask it to reply: the whole email shows on a card, and nothing is sent until you tap Confirm.
Every half hour it offers to-dos from what comes in, on Today under “From your email”. Tap Add or Not needed.

title: Place look-ups have a monthly allowance
lines: Arvy can look up 450 places a month on Google Maps for each of you. That keeps it free.
Days you don’t use it carry over: the allowance is for the whole month.
If a month runs out, Arvy tells you. It starts again on the 1st.

title: Video calls, in your chat
lines: Your chat has a video button at the top. Tap it to call.
The other one gets a notification. Tap it, then Answer. With the planner open, a banner drops in and rings.
Mute, camera off, flip the camera and hang up are at the bottom of the call.
If it says “Couldn’t connect”, try again on Wi-Fi and tell Arvy: that’s the sign we need to add a relay.

title: Christmas emoji, a full set
lines: The emoji tray in your chat now shows one theme at a time. It opens on what’s coming up next: Christmas.
Christmas has 32 of its own: laughing, a kiss, a hug, thumbs up, thank you, sad, cross, sleepy, ill, and things like hot chocolate and a gingerbread man.
Tap the small pictures under the heading for the other themes.

title: Theme Studio: 21 looks for your planner
lines: Settings › Theme Studio. Pick a look and the whole planner changes: colours, lettering, cards, buttons and a wallpaper of its own.
21 to choose from: Woodland, Cottagecore, Pastels, Christmas, Autumn, Dark Academia, Celestial, Minimalist and 13 more.
Any section can wear a different look, and you can put a photo of your own behind it all.
Icons, stickers and widgets are at the bottom of the Studio. “Back to the planner’s own look” undoes everything.

title: Stickers for your pages
lines: Settings › Stickers: pick a page and dress it up like a scrapbook.
149 stickers: animals, flowers, bows, washi tape, arrows, mood faces, paper pieces.
Drag to move, drag a corner to resize, the round handle to turn. Add pictures of your own under Mine.
Tap Done and they stay on the page, out of the way of your taps.

title: Reply to a message, and hand messages to Arvy
lines: In your chat, swipe a message to the right to reply to it. The quote shows above your reply; tap it to go back to the original.
Press and hold a message to pick it, tap others to add them, then choose Reply, Ask Arvy or Copy.
Ask Arvy can put them on the shopping list, make a to-do for either of you, put them on the calendar, or log them as an idea for the planner. Nothing is added until you tap Confirm.

title: Icon packs, and your own pictures as icons
lines: Settings › Icons: pick a pack for the bar and the Health and Lifestyle pages: Woodland, Cottage, Celestial, Festive, Academia, Coastal, Spooky, Retro or Blossom.
“Match my look” will change the icons with your look by itself once the looks arrive.
Or put your own picture on any button, and take it off any time.

title: Arrange your Today page
lines: Settings › Arrange Today: put the blocks on Today in your own order, switch off the ones you don’t use, and make some smaller. The day’s plan always stays.
Add widgets: a countdown to a day you pick, a sticky note, a mini calendar and a habit tracker for the week.
“Put it back as it was” restores the original page.

title: Arvy finds places, and reads your chat when you ask
lines: Ask Arvy for a dentist, a physio or any place: it looks it up on Google Maps and tells you if it’s open.
Under its reply are buttons to call, open the website or book online, and get directions.
Arvy can’t book for you. Once you’ve booked, tell it the day and time and it puts it on the calendar.
Ask “what did we say about dinner?” and Arvy reads your chat with each other. It only looks when you ask.

title: Wish lists, with a secret “got it”
lines: Shopping has a new side: Wish lists. Add what you’d love, with the price, where it’s from and up to three pictures.
“Add from a screenshot” keeps the picture and fills in what it can read, for you to check.
You each see the other’s list, what it comes to and what’s still to get.
Tap “I’ve got it” on one of their wishes and only you see it. They see nothing until you tap “It’s been given”.

title: Emoji packs for every occasion
lines: The smiley beside the message box in your chat now opens packs of our own emoji: themed smileys and drawings for Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day, Easter, Diwali, Halloween and birthdays.
Tap them into a message along with your words. A message that is only emoji shows them big.
The box shows an ordinary look-alike while you type; the preview just above it shows how the message will look.

title: A gold bevelled edge on the RV button
lines: The big button now has an embossed gold rim, like the edge of a coin.

title: The big button wears the RV logo
lines: The word under it is gone and the button is bigger: it now carries the RV-and-sparkle mark, the same drawing as your notification icon.
It works as before: tap for Arvy, hold to talk, drag up and right for your chat.

title: Send Arvy a screenshot of an appointment
lines: Paste a screenshot into Arvy’s chat, or tap the picture button beside the message box, and send it. No words needed.
Arvy reads the appointment off it and sets it up for the calendar: tap Confirm and it’s on.
Works for a text, an email, a booking page, a flyer or a school letter, several appointments at once, and long scrolling screenshots.
In your chat with each other you can paste pictures now too.

title: Stickers in your chat
lines: Tap the smiley beside the message box: our own little moving stickers for Halloween, Diwali, Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day, Easter and birthdays.
The occasion coming up next is always first, with a countdown.
Put your birthdays on the calendar as yearly events and they count down there too.

title: A new small notification icon
lines: The planner’s small icon in the status bar is now VR with a sparkle.

title: Notifications come from the Planner app
lines: They now come through the Planner app itself, not through Chrome, so they carry Planner’s icon and follow the Planner app’s notification settings on your phone.
Nothing to do: this phone moved over when you opened the planner after the update.

title: Tidier notifications, and a check for them
lines: Several chat messages in a row now show as one notification that lists them, not just the last one.
The planner has its own small icon in the status bar.
Settings › Reminders › Check notifications says where they stop if none arrive, and what to change on the phone.

title: A chat for the two of you, with Arvy reading along
lines: Drag RV up and let go to the right for your chat with each other. Up and to the left is Arvy, as before. There’s also a chat button at the top of Arvy’s panel.
Send words, photos and short videos. A red dot on RV means there’s something new.

When one of you asks for something (“can you get apples”, “dentist Thursday at 3”), Arvy offers to put it on the shopping list, the calendar or a to-do list. Nothing is added until one of you taps Confirm.
Turn on notifications (Settings › Reminders) to hear when a message comes in.

title: Arvy tells you what’s new
lines: After an update, Arvy posts what changed here in the chat, and sends a notification if they’re on.
Ask “what’s new?” any time.

title: GoodLife class times
lines: Ask Arvy about a class (“yoga at Queenston or Burlington today?”): it reads GoodLife’s live timetable, with spots left.
Pick one and it goes on the calendar after Confirm. Booking the spot is still done in the GoodLife app.

title: Set up your day
lines: Four short steps set your day’s times, habits, last period and reminders. Settings › Set up my day again runs them any time.
The cycle tracker asks for your latest period instead of counting from an old one.

title: The new bottom bar, and Arvy on the web
lines: Today · RV · Health · Wealth · Lifestyle. Hold RV to talk.
Drag Health up for a meal photo, Wealth up for a receipt photo.
Arvy can search the web, offer options as buttons, and shows its sources.
